levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن المبارك

notes: «أَبي» is named only by relation (rule 7); HKG and K6I give the father a name the text does not write
«أنه سمع عبد الله بن عمر» makes Ibn Umar a link (rule 5); «عمر بن الخطاب» is the Companion whose account is the saying
«عثمان» in the story is not a link (rule 6); «قال يعني» and the dash gloss are left out

fixes.reason: K6I and HKG attach a name (إبراهيم بن سعد) to the relation «أبي», which the text does not write.
